WebAssembly Core 1.0 `i32.load` forms its effective integer address by adding the instruction’s static offset to its address operand. It traps if that address plus four bytes exceeds the byte length of its memory. The operation is a validated full-width `i32.load` in the December 2019 Core 1.0 profile. The four-byte width is specific to full-width i32.load. Narrow loads have different widths. This addresses the bounds test, independent of host buffering and JavaScript API errors.
